research_updates.title: Electric, water and wastewater audit finds capacity but no meter
research_updates.notes: Nevada utility-regulatory dockets, Switch SEC filings, TRI-GID and NDEP water records were searched for load, meter, bill, tariff, interconnection, reclaimed-water delivery, discharge and customer contribution. The public materials describe 130 MW available at Tahoe Reno 1 full build-out, a regional effluent pipeline, maximum campus cooling demand and a zero-discharge permit. No project meter, kWh, peak demand, utility bill or payment, interconnection cost, actual water volume or Tahoe Reno 1 allocation was found.

research_updates.title: Employment and wage outcome models fail causal and identity gates
research_updates.notes: BLS QCEW and repository county panels provide Storey County covered employment and wage context but cannot identify Switch employees, contractors, residents or Tahoe Reno 1. The campus opened amid simultaneous Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center growth, including Tesla and later Google development; no comparison county, parallel-trend diagnostic, stable treatment share or single building treatment date was established. Legacy employment-comparison and wage-comparison gaps therefore require removal: they are descriptive arithmetic presented as project-linked outcomes and do not support causal attribution.

research_updates.title: GDP outcome model fails causal and allocation gates

The legacy GDP comparison gap requires removal rather than being described as a project effect.
